name: gcc
description: GNU Compiler Collection providing C and C++ compilers and their associated runtime libraries.
build: cd gcc-15.3.0 && mkdir -p build && cd build && ../configure --prefix="$PREFIX" LD=ld --enable-languages=c,c++ --enable-default-pie --enable-default-ssp --enable-host-pie --disable-multilib --disable-bootstrap --disable-fixincludes --with-system-zlib
